metadata.source: Certified 2026 Verona Township Fiscal Baseline & NJ Title 54

coreInequities.title: High Residential Reliance
coreInequities.description: With 88.2% of the property tax levy borne by homeowners, unforeseen municipal or school costs directly inflate residential bills.
coreInequities.remedy: Expand commercial ratables and pursue shared services to mitigate residential exposure.

coreInequities.title: Assessment Base Calibration
coreInequities.description: Verona Township operates at an equalization ratio of 79.5%, requiring state equalization adjustments for county tax apportionment.
coreInequities.remedy: Continuous annual revaluation adjustments to maintain assessments at 100% true market value.

presetScenarios.name: Status Quo (Current Baseline 2026)
presetScenarios.summary: Existing certified baseline for 2026. Homeowners shoulder 88.2% of the levy, commercial ratables pay 11.8%, and schools receive zero PILOT funds.
presetScenarios.winners: Commercial entities with long-term abatements and corporate tax appeal attorneys.
presetScenarios.losers: Single-family homeowners, fixed-income seniors, and Verona Township public school students.

presetScenarios.name: Commercial Ratable Protection & Reval Equity
presetScenarios.summary: Full commercial reassessment ensures corporate properties pay on 100% fair market value, expanding commercial share and cutting homeowner millage.
presetScenarios.winners: Residential homeowners and small local merchants.
presetScenarios.losers: Under-assessed corporate office parks and strip center operators.

presetScenarios.name: State-Mandated PILOT School Sharing
presetScenarios.summary: Statutory distribution of municipal PILOT service fees to Verona Township Public Schools eliminates residential tax shift for new students.
presetScenarios.winners: Verona Township Public Schools students and local residential taxpayers.

presetScenarios.name: State Property Tax Relief Integration (ANCHOR + PTR)
presetScenarios.summary: 100% enrollment of eligible seniors and working-class families in ANCHOR ($1,500–$1,750) and Senior Freeze (PTR) programs.
presetScenarios.winners: Fixed-income seniors (age 65+), disabled homeowners, and low-to-moderate income renters.

presetScenarios.name: Comprehensive Tax Modernization Blueprint
presetScenarios.summary: All 4 major taxpayer reforms enacted: commercial reassessment, PILOT school sharing, maximum ANCHOR enrollment, and shared municipal dispatch.
presetScenarios.winners: All Verona Township residential homeowners, school families, and local businesses.
presetScenarios.losers: Special-interest tax appeal lobbyists and unvetted PILOT developers.

policyRoadmap.title: Establish Municipal Shared Service Compact
policyRoadmap.description: Formally join Essex County cooperative purchasing agreements for road resurfacing materials, salt, and emergency dispatch.

policyRoadmap.title: MOD-IV Annual Assessment Roll Calibration
policyRoadmap.description: Maintain certified assessments within 5% of equalized market value to eliminate county tax appeal exposure.
policyRoadmap.impact: Protects against sudden tax appeal refund spikes.

policyRoadmap.title: Pass PILOT Accountability Ordinance
policyRoadmap.description: Require all future long-term tax exemption agreements to allocate an education impact fee directly to public schools.
policyRoadmap.impact: Safeguards residential homeowners from absorption of school funding burdens.
